text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've had a truly awful day. After trying to
stick to
my guns a little too stubbornly, I
ended up really
upsetting one of my
colleagues.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling guilty and exhausted, I decide
to visit an
izakaya bar but end up going
overboard and
completely incapacitate
myself with drink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing I can do but dimly watch
as
passersby give me a wide berth and
hurry along.
Just when I begin to feel
completely at a loss...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, someone's had a few too many.
Are you
okay? Can you stand?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Aren't you a trainer from the
academy?
What happened?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You don't actually think you can
fool me
with that, do you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's get you somewhere safe. But first,
I'll go buy
you some water! Hang tight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her kindness and the alcohol loosen my
tongue,
and I wind up telling her
everything that
happened while she
takes care of me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So you figured you'd drink your
problems away,
huh? You've had a
rough day!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You regret not handling your feelings in
a more
productive way? Hm... I mean, I
get it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But I really do understand where you're
coming
from. I'm one to go with my
feelings, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I always want to be true to myself, but I
always
end up losing myself instead...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh! I have to get going!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What are you going to do? Are you
going to rest
here, or do you want me to
call you a taxi?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All right. Well, I do have to leave, but...
Make
sure you don't pass out here,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, okay. I'll stick around until the
taxi comes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hello? I'd like to request a taxi...
